def solution():
    # Define variables
    option_type = "call"
    strike_price = 0.03
    premium = 0.015
    yield_at_expiry = 0.035
    multiplier = 100

    # Calculate the option's intrinsic value and net profit/loss
    intrinsic_value = max(
        0,
        (yield_at_expiry - strike_price) * multiplier
    )
    profit_loss = intrinsic_value - (premium * multiplier)

    # Return the result rounded to the nearest integer
    return round(profit_loss)
